labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Names a specific broken link (AI_POLICY.md on master) in CONTRIBUTING.md; documentation takes precedence over contribution process.

items.body:
This is a documentation report. The `AI_POLICY.md` link on line 9 of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) points to the `master` branch, and the report says the file is only on `main`. A maintainer will check the link.

On the pull request: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) asks contributors to describe a change in an issue first, and pull requests follow AI_POLICY.md. This issue describes the fix, and #4203 covers the wider question of when pull requests are open to contributors.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
